name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-map-update-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; value:cloneReadOnly is absent.
reason: The expected panic on updating m3 depends on m2.cloneReadOnly() producing a frozen map. cloneReadOnly is excluded from both the supported langlib functions and method-call list, so this essential behavior is outside subset 10.
unsupported_constructs: Langlib value:cloneReadOnly invoked using method syntax, including the frozen-map mutation panic it enables.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts failure on the final indexed map assignment.
